claim: Microsoft revenue fell 17% year over year in the third quarter of fiscal 2024
summary: Microsoft's fiscal Q3 2024 revenue increased ~17% year-over-year to $61.9B, not fell 17%; the claim inverts the actual reported direction of change.

sub_claims.text: Microsoft revenue fell year-over-year in the third quarter of fiscal 2024
sub_claims.stated_text: Microsoft revenue fell 17% year over year in the third quarter of fiscal 2024
sub_claims.note: FY24 Q3 is Jan-Mar 2024; Microsoft reported YoY revenue growth of ~17%, not a decline, so direction is opposite of claim.

sub_claims.text: The year-over-year change was a decline of 17%
sub_claims.note: Actual YoY change was +17% (increase from ~$52.9B to $61.9B); a -17% change is contradicted.
